title: Burning reeds and plastic reed wear
summary: Hall describes burning the tip of a reed with a German cap and a coin, and notes plastic reeds chip after about a month.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Well, I tell you what, I got a cap for, it's German made. I bought the climate just for the ligature. Oh, yeah. You see the cap on your. No, this is too round. See how that mouthpiece, I mean that reed is cut. See if you put it on there, you find out that it's...

See, this one is too round. I don't know, you may, you may can do it, but you can tell. Because, but this cap is just right. So I just take it and put that reed on there, just about how much I want. And take a match and light it. And I just point it all the way around. Just a little tip in it. Ralph and I were laughing one day, let's see.

Somebody said a nickel and I think... No, a nickel is too small. A nickel is too small. Professor Minetta said he uses a quarter and the baby dogs. I never got to talk to Johnny much about it. I knew Johnny quite well, but never in those days I went to hear it.

I use a half a dollar, we'll do it. Johnny used a half a dollar, baby said. Yeah, that's right. I use a half a dollar. But this particular cap that I got is a German made cap. It's just right. Because it's shaped just like, just like the reed when I bought it. And if you both do it right, that's alright. Of course they got another thing too that you can buy to cut a reed.
Oh yeah, sure. You can buy a reed, they call them a reed cutter. Oh, I see. Well I never did fool with this. Because it's heavy too and you got to carry it in the case.
I was going to say, after you burned it, do you find it splits pretty soon after that?

No, I don't know. It looks like, I don't know, after you... It lasts you for a while, but it's not as good as, you know, when I was a little bit of a reed, I mean, so, like a ridge. I'm going to put it on there. I would imagine, I would imagine a burned reed is kind of a rock.

I tell you what, when you remember you asked me about a plastic reed. Now that plastic reed, you could use a plastic reed for about a month. But eventually it starts to chipping off right on the end by the vibration, you know what I mean? Then you have to change it. Oh, I see. And the minute it gets at least a little nick in a plastic reed, you feel it right. A cane reed is the same way. Yeah. Sometime I be playing and all at once the reed don't feel the same. When you look at it, it's just a little nick on it. And it's the movement.
